sloka: सो अहम् अभ्यवहार अर्थम् तौ दृष्ट्वा कृत निश्चयः ।तेन साम्ना विनीतेन पन्थानम् अनुयाचितः ॥४-५९-१५॥
transliteration: so aham abhyavahāra artham tau dṛṣṭvā kṛta niścayaḥ ।tena sāmnā vinītena panthānam anuyācitaḥ ॥4-59-15॥

translations.english: 'Since I was looking for food I resolved to seize both of them. (But) he asked me in a gentle and courteous manner to make way (since I was blocking the aerial path).
